messages.An independent, unofficial interface for:
An independent, unofficial interface for the installed CyberGhost Linux CLI.

Use Setup in the header to install the CLI or configure your account.

Ctrl+F: search locations   ·   F5: refresh   ·   Ctrl+Q: quit

The app stores only your choices and favorites. Linux handles administrator authorization. Quitting leaves your VPN connection as it is.

messages.From the extracted CyberGhost download f:
From the extracted CyberGhost download folder:
sudo bash install.sh

To configure an already installed CLI:
sudo cyberghostvpn --setup

Setup needs Bash, sudo and a terminal (GNOME Terminal, Ptyxis, Konsole, Xfce Terminal or xterm). Connection buttons need pkexec and your desktop's polkit authentication agent. Install missing tools through your distribution's package manager.
